xmldoc.short_description: Reinitialize Nelson’s search path directory cache.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector or string scalar: 'path', 'toolbox', 'pathreset', 'toolboxreset' or 'toolboxcache'. Every option rescans the path and reloads the changed files.

description.p: rehash() reinitializes Nelson’s search path directory cache.
Function, script, private and class files changed on disk (write time or size) since they were loaded are reloaded on their next call.
This happens each time a command is run from the prompt, for the files of the folders added with addpath, the current folder and the user path.
You should use rehash() only when you run a .m file that updates another .m file and calls it before returning to the prompt.

history_item.history_description: changed files are reloaded from the prompt and by rehash; option argument added.
